help.title: Help
help.metaDescription: Need support? Find answers about using Balancefy and learn how to make the most of all app features.
help.howToAddTransactionP1: To register a new transaction, follow the steps below: Click the "New Transaction" button or the + icon.
help.howToAddTransactionP2: Fill in the required information such as transaction description, value, category, date, then click "Add" to confirm.
help.howToAddTransactionP3: The new transaction will automatically appear in the transaction list.
help.howToDeleteTransactionP1: If you need to remove an existing transaction:
help.howToDeleteTransactionP2: Find the transaction in the list. Click the three-dot icon next to the transaction. Click delete.
help.howToDeleteTransactionP3: Warning: this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
help.howToEditTransactionP1: If you need to correct any information:
help.howToEditTransactionP2: Find the transaction in the list. Click the three dots and edit. Change the necessary fields (title, value, category or date). Click "Save changes".
help.howToEditTransactionP3: Changes will be updated immediately in the list.
help.howToAddWalletP1: To register a new wallet, follow the steps below: Go to the wallets page and click the "New Wallet" button or the + icon.
help.howToAddWalletP2: Fill in the wallet name, then click "Add" to confirm.
help.howToAddWalletP3: The new wallet will automatically appear in the wallet list, and you can link transactions to it.
help.howToAddCategoryP1: To register a new category, follow the steps below: Go to the categories page and click the "New Category" button or the + icon.
help.howToAddCategoryP2: Fill in the category name and color, then click "Add" to confirm.
help.howToAddCategoryP3: The new category will automatically appear in the category list, and you can link transactions to it.
